verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents many channel integrations (Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, etc.) and gateway-level security features (sandboxing, secrets management, security audit, multi-tenant cells) but contains no mention of sender allowlists, DM approval policies, or mention-gating for inbound messages. Community commentary even notes the security model is coarse ('equivalent to running as root'), reinforcing that fine-grained inbound message gating is not evidenced.
